balls.text: Length ball on off, slammed down to long-off. They rush back for two. LSG finish on 203 for 8
Short and wide outside off, he misses the slash. Called wide. MI review

Maiden five-wicket haul in T20s for Hardik Pandya! The MI owners are delighted. This is short and wide outside off, Akash Deep hops and slashes it over the off side. Looks good until Santner gets across at deep backward point and grabs it

Hardik picks up his fourth to send the dangerous MIller packing! Length ball on leg, 131.7kph, he swats across the line to hit it over deep midwicket but finds Dhir to perfection. First four-for for Hardik in the IPL
Strays down leg and pays the price. Short and down leg, 125.1kph, Miller swivels and pulls it fine down leg to bring up the 200 for LSG
Connects this time! Low full toss on middle and leg, Miller clears his front leg and swats it over long-on. Hardik not happy with the fielder's set-up - much straighter than he wanted prolly
Length ball on leg, slower one again, Miller looks to go big but slogs it high in the air. Lands well short of deep midwicket running in. Miller gets to 3000 IPL runs with that

Top edge and it nearly goes all the way! The slower bouncer on leg, 112.2kph, Thakur goes back to swivel and pull but gets it well over short fine leg. Desired result, even if not in the desired manner
Full and straight on middle, the slower one, squeezed back over the bowler towards the straightish mid-off
Full and straight on leg, 137kph, clipped through square leg to get going

Pulled straight to deep midwicket charging in! This is the off-pace ball from Boult now, just 116.1kph, Samad has to manufacture the pace to this short ball that is angled away from him. He cannot do much than hit it down towards Dhir in the deep. MI finding the right speeds to derail LSG at the death
Fuller on middle and leg, driven down to long-on

Thick edge, flies over short third. Wide line outside off, on a fuller length at just 114kph, Miller goes hard at it and gets it off the outside edge. Puthur, the shortest man in the Mi line-up, leaps but cannot reach it
Oh yes! Samad up and running on the first ball This is short and fast from Hardik, 125.1kph, Samad gets on his toes and pulls it away from deep midwicket

Hardk can do little wrong tonight! Pace off is game on for him. Another offcutter well wide outside off, Markram has to go for it. Looks to hit it over extra cover. But the ball does not come to him as quickly as he expects. As a result, he ends up dragging it to Bawa, who rushes to his left from long-off and takes it with a slide
Fuller and wider outside off, he gets it off the inner half through forward square leg
Length ball outside off, 121.6kph, slapped to cover-point, where Vignesh makes a half-stop
Length ball on leg, clipped through square leg
Length ball outside off, 123.3kph, Markram gets a thick inside edge through backward square leg
Bouncer outside off, 127.2kph, Markram thinks of pulling but pulls away. Called wide for height
Wrong'un on a length, slapped down to long-off, just nine off his last over, impressive stuff from Vignesh
Fires it on a length wide outside off, he leaves it be. Marginal call, given wide
Spins away from a length around off, punched down to long-on
Spins away from a length, slapped straight to SKY at cover
Full on leg, knocked down to long-on to bring up a fifty off just 34 balls
Another loopy ball on off, spins away, 81.2kph, punched through cover
Nails the sweep! Floated full on middle and off, 80.7kph, Miller reaches out and drills it through square leg
Length ball angling in to leg, 135.1kph, clipped through square leg to keep strike

And the wide line works for Ashwani and MI! Another slower offcutter, well wide outside off. Badoni once again moves across to repeat the scoop. This ball was not as full as the previous one. Plus it was slower, as a result, Badoni was early in the shot. Gets a top edge that Rickelton takes with a leap. Good little innings from Badoni this
Smart, smart stuff, Badoni! He walks across early anticipating the line from Ashwani. He goes with the plan and Badoni scoops it over the vacant short fine leg region
Lands it on a length on middle and leg, again off-pace at 110.7kph, punched down to long-on
Shorter slower one angling away, punched to cover-point
Over extra cover for a magnificent hit! Ashwani once again goes for the wide yorker but overpitches. Markram is well in position to get under it and deposits it for a maximum
Full and wide outside off, he lets it be
Dropped? Another slower one in the slot, 116.8kph, Markram backs away to go over the off side but almost hits it down to long-off. Jacks runs to his left and gets low but the ball lands just short
Another slower one on a length, he hangs back to steer it away but hits it straight to backward point
Slower short ball on off and middle, 118.9kph, pulled through backward square leg. Bawa dives to his right in the deep and saves one
Outside off on a length, he delays the punch through point. And there is a poor throw, well wide of the wicketkeeper that results in another run. Boult the fielder at deep backward point
Length ball on off and middle, climbs a bit more, 117kph. He rides the extra bounce and pushes it to long-on
Begins with a length ball on middle, pulled through backward square leg
Charges down early but then goes back, as the ball is on a length and slow (78.2kph). Cut to deep cover. Santner finishes with 0 for 46, his most expensive IPL figures
Fuller outside off, driven to deep cover
Length on off, skids through with the arm, keeps a bit low, squeezed through midwicket
Badoni is toying with Santner now! Sees the ball dropping on a length just outside off, he goes back, slashes it past backward point. Deep cover has no chance
And now to the other side. Santner travelling in his final over. Quicker and fuller outside off, Badoni gets slightly across, reaches out and sweeps it well wide of deep midwicket
Superb. Finally Badoni connects one and it looks SOOO good! Tossed up around off, he charges down and goes inside out over extra cover
Quicker and on a length outside off, the wrong'un, cut through point for just one
Dances down the track to go straight but gets it off the outer half over cover. Badoni not getting the measure of the surface and the bowler for now
Superb work from Jacks at the long-off boundary. Markram muscles the tossed up ball down the ground but Jacks keeps it down to one
Nicely tossed up on off, Badoni miscues it over cover
Leading edge through mid-off as Markram looks to work the googly through the on side
Tossed up on middle and leg, slogged to deep midwicket
Flatter and quicker just outside off, he goes back to punch it past backward point. It is well away from the man in the deep, so Markram gets back for the second easily
Flatter on middle, tucked through square leg
Fuller around off, he presses forward and blocks

Plumb in front? Looked so and MI review. Santner bowls this wide from the crease, quite full on leg. Badoni looks to reach out and sweep but misses. The ball passes under his blade and hits him low on the front pad. Umpire's call for impact (over 2.5m) and clipping the bails, so again umpire's call. Narrow escape for Badoni, Santner cannot believe it
Fuller on leg, turned through midwicket
The quicker it comes, the quicker it goes. Fired in on a length outside off, 95.1kph, Markram goes deep and cuts it through point. It actually went through Boult at backward point

Huge appeal for caught behind. Umpires unmoved and they will probably take a look at the height. MI think about the review but don't take it. Badoni looks to pull another bumper from outside off, but misses. Nothing on Ultra-Edge
Back of a length just outside off, Badoni gets away from the line, called wide for height, 135.3kph
Length ball outside off, steered to backward point

Brilliantly taken, superb catch from Bosch, the sub, and Pant is out of here! Hardik uses more of the surface to extend Pant's lean run. Digs the offcutter in the surface, 122.4kph, he looks to tuck it across but is early into the shot. Gets the leading edge towards the off side, Bosch runs in from mid-off, dives full-stretch to gobble it up. LSG's captain continues to have a bad time
Length ball on leg, 129.3kph, defended back down the track
Slower one angling in, nudged through midwicket
Swung over deep third! The fielder there was briefly interested but it keeps sailing over. Short and wide, Markram arches back and ramps it away in style
Tossed up at 87.3kph on middle, he steps down the track and pushes this back to Puthur
Gently tossed up outside off, he chips this to long-off for a run
Dragged down and punished! Wrong'un again, but that was rather short outside off. Markram hops back and slams this away over wide long-on for an 80m six
Wrong'un just around off stump, he can only push this back towards the bowler
Fuller on leg stump, he digs this out and pushes to long-on
Tossed up on off, he stretches forward and defends back to the bowler
Good length ball on middle and leg at 124.4kph, he turns this to deep square leg to get off the mark
The change in pace does the trick and Pooran's innings ends early. Slower bouncer outside off stump. Pooran goes for a pull, is in no control whatsoever and spoons a simple catch to short fine leg
On-pace back of a length ball outside off, he pushes towards cover and takes a run
Into the pitch but that was well down leg. Called a wide.
Smart! Slower back of a length delivery on the shorter side and well outside off. Markram eyes a cut, but is deceived by the lack of pace. Gets beaten
Another slower offcutter on off, Markram pushes back to the bowler
Slower back of a length offcutter outside off, he pushes to deep cover
Flatter outside off, he mistimes his cut to point and they take a run
TONKED! Length ball on off, he takes a step forward and thumps this over straight down the ground. Nothing long-on could have done there
One ball... that's all the sighters that Pooran needs. Darted in at 96.1kph on middle but right in his arc. Pooran gets down on one knee and slams this for an 83m six over deep midwicket
Flatter on middle, Pooran defends
Fired in on middle at 93.6kph, Markram gets his bat down in time and pushes past short extra cover. There was a slight miscommunication but no harm done as the ball goes to long-off
Flatter on leg stump as Markram works this to midwicket

Puthur gets Marsh first ball! He is showing his wares and Marsh has no answers. Wrong'un outside legstump, Marsh was looking to work this away to the on-side, gets a bit of a leading edge back towards Puthur who takes a smart catch diving to his left.
Tad short outside off, he pats this to the left of extra cover and sets off
Markram gets into the act... finally. Tossed up on middle and leg, he gets forward and slogs this miles over cow corner. An 85m six for him
84.9kph length ball angling across Markram who punches to extra cover
Dragged down but Markram can't take full toll. Was short and wide outside off, Markram tried to whack that away and can only mistime to point
Fuller outside off, he drives to extra cover

WOWZA! What an over this has been for LSG and Marsh, and Ashwani has been given a rude awakening. Knee-high full toss outside off, Marsh presents the full face of the bat and just punches this past his partner. 23 off that over.
CLUBBED! Gentle length ball angling across Marsh, bludgeons this through cover. Already 19 off this over.
Good length ball and down leg, Marsh has a waft at it and misses. Called a wide

Slower length ball outside off, Marsh is through the drive early and skews this off the inside half of the blade. But such is the power of the man, that even the mistime hits are travelling. Long-on races to his right and saves two by putting in a dive

Now, he goes fuller and Marsh works this behind square for a couple of runs. And that will get Marsh a fifty off just 27 balls. He has had the bulk of the strike in the powerplay and cashed in brilliantly.
Muscled this away to the leg side! Short of good length on middle, and Marsh has picked the length so quickly. He gets into position and thumps the pull to the left of deep backward square leg

Straight as an arrow and all the way! Ashwani goes length and on middle, he steps down and just extends his arms so cleanly. The ball went very high and just over the boundary hoardings. Lovely straight face of the blade there from Marsh
Hangs this on a length just around off stump at 89.7kph as Marsh eases this to long-off for a run
Two in two! Short and wide outside off, he rocks back and thumps this through covers. Not a soul moved.
Lovely shot! Flatter and just a touch short on middle and leg. He bends down on one knee and sweeps this hard past square leg
Oh, that's kept low. Flatter on leg stump, Markram adjusts and tucks this to the on-side
Gives himself some room but Santner is up to the task. Bowls this flatter at 96kph on middle cramping the batter for room. He can only punch this to wide long-off
Tossed up on middle, Marsh defends
On a good length just around off stump, he defends back to the bowler
Another sharp good length ball on off, he fends this to the off side and takes  a run
Oh, raps him on the gloves. He's quicker than what he looks, does Ashwani. Gets the good length ball to pitch on middle and skid through quickly rapping Marsh on the gloves who defends meekly
Lovely, flourishing drive but Bawa has stopped a certain four. Fuller in length outside off, he creams the drive to the left of Bawa at cover, who puts in a full-length dive and saves three
Rising good length ball just around off stump as Marsh defends close to his feet and sets off
On a length on middle and leg to start off, Marsh defends back towards the bowler
Sharp back of a length ball angling across Markram who looks for a backfoot punch and misses. Pandya is interested, but gets no support from Rickelton or Boult
Back of a length ball outside off, he bunts this to backward point and sets off

How's that gone for four? I guess, that's the power of the man. Fuller-length ball well outside off stump, Marsh gets it right off the bottom half of the blade to the right of Boult and the ball has sped across on the outfield
Good length ball on middle and leg, he works this towards midwicket uppishly
BANG! Too full on off stump and Marsh extends his arms and goes straight down the ground. That was one heck of a clean strike and goes over the ropes
Stifle appeal for lbw... not given. Think that was high. Back of a length ball on off, he goes for a pull, misses and is rapped on the thigh pad. That was certainly high
Fuller well outside off, Marsh throws his bat at it and gets it off the cue end of the blade towards mid-on
Fuller outside off stump and Marsh lays into the drive as he threads the gap between mid-off and extra cover. Did not get all of it, but placed it well enough
Right in Marsh's arc and punished. Banged in short on off and middle, he gets in position nice and early and hacks the pull to the deep midwicket fence.
Back of a length ball down leg, called a wide.
Sharp inswinger to Marsh that starts from well outside off and meets the batter on off. He defends
Another good length ball outside off with a hint of shape away as Markram gets across and pushes towards point for a run

Oh, deft touch at its best. And that's a superb way for Markram to get going. Back of a length ball outside off, he waits for it and opens the face of the blade at the last moment to guide it to the left of deep point. Excellent placement.
On a good length angling across from Marsh outside off, he gets across and shoulders arms
On a length around off stump, Marsh gets right behind it and defends back to the bowler
Good riposte! On a length angling away from Marsh who throws his hands at it and is lucky to not get an edge on that

IMPERIOUS! Not a lot of swing there for Boult. He pitches it up on off and middle, just a hint of inward movement as Marsh presents the full face of the bat and drives on the up to the right of mid-off
Fuller swinging sharply back into Marsh on leg stump. He misses the flick and is rapped on the pad. That was sliding down leg, though.
Off the mark straight away. On a length shaping back into Marsh on middle and leg, he works this well in front of square
Full and wide outside off, he swings it across straight to midwicket in the ring. LSG win by 12 runs and get to four points, their first win at home in IPL 2025
Low full toss outside off, his bottom hand comes off as he toe ends it towards long-off. Throws his bat away in frustration as he completes the run
Is that it for MI? Avesh bowls it full outside off, Hardik swings across the line but gets a thick inside edge onto his front pad. Lucknow roars
Low full toss on leg, swiped through square leg to the man in the deep. He does not take the run
Yorker on leg, flicked through midwicket for a couple
Hardik bludgeons it over cover! Keep how many ever you want there, he says. Low full toss outside off, he has a stable base and just powers it into the deep cover stands, MI believe

Back of a length on leg, pulled through forward square leg. They HAVE TO take a second to get Hardik back on strike for the next over. They run on the throw and the throw is very wide, almost mid-pitch. Superb penultimate over from Thakur this one, just seven off it
Goes for the wide yorker outside off, slips in another low full toss at 132.4kph. Hardik can only slash it to deep point and take one
Low full toss on leg, hit straight to long-on
Thakur gets away with a full toss! Hardik slices it to deep backward point for just one
Shahbaz, the sub, saves a certain boundary at cover! Flings himself to his left in the ring to parry it towards mid-off. Full and wide outside off, Tilak crashed it off the back foot
Goes for the yorker, just misses his mark on the shorter side outside off, drilled to Miller at deep cover
Length ball, angling away outside off, punched to deep cover to keep strike, 11 off Rathi's final over of the night
Sprays it down leg on a fullish length, 96.8kph, Hardik gets down to sweep. Gets a tickle and it runs away fine. Pant not happy with the line Rathi is bowling there
Fuller on leg, slogs it through backward square leg. More work for Miller in the deep, MI get two more
Misfield from Avesh concedes an extra run. Hardik directs the length ball down leg towards short fine leg. He over-runs it and lets it through
Spinning away from a length, reaches out to hit it to long-off. Still hasn't found his timing on this surface Tilak
Fuller on middle, driven straight back but Rathi does not stop it
Edged but Tilak won't mind. Bouncer outside off, 122.7kph, Tilak looks to ramp it over third but gets it over the wicketkeeper. Just the second boundary for TV tonight
Yorker just outside off, dug out towards backward point
Digs it in, angles it in, heaved away to long-on. Just 119kph that, Tilak did not middle that
Bangs it short from around the stumps, 133.7kph, Tilak looks to pull but doesn't make contact. Flies over his head down leg
Length ball outside off, slapped to deep cover
Off the mark in style. Juicy full toss outside off, Hardik drives it straight back past the bowler

Suryakumar is off his feet and is out of the ground now! An unorthodox shot brings his downfall, Avesh roars in celebration. Length ball, well wide outside off, 126.9kph. SKY reaches out and looks to scoop it over short fine leg. Generally makes good contact to exploit fine leg region but this time hits it in the air towards deep backward square leg. Samad covers good ground, eyes on the ball, and takes a running catch to bring about the most important wicket for LSG. Timely strike for them
Half-tracker down leg, he looks to heave it away but gets a leading edge over the leg umpire. Nine off Bishnoi's last over
SKY finds the boundary! Bishnoi can only afford a wry smile. He fired it full and wide outside off, Suryakumar reaches out to sweep. Gets it very fine and merely beats short fine leg
Spins away from a length outside off, punched to backward point. Dot ball is gold dust at this stage
Shortish on middle, heaved to deep midwicket
Dropped! Tilak gets a life. Bishnoi pushes this wide, he lofts it inside out but hits it towards the man running in from deep backward point. Dives forward and shells it
Full outside off, the wrong'un, mistimes the slog to long-on

Huge mix-up! Suryakumar looks to go big over the off side but the ball moves in and takes the inside edge. Not too far from leg stump and he starts running. Sees short fine leg dive and get to the ball and aborts. By then Tilak has crossed him but both are stranded in the middle. Direct hit at the striker's end would have been curtains for tis partnership
Back of a length outside off, 129.9kph, he looks to ramp but misses
Full and wide again, this time drives it wide of extra cover for two
Lofted inside out over cover, glorious! Akash Deep goes full and outside off, this is not the length that will bother SKY, that too at 137.4kph. Suryakumar gets under it, lifts it with a flourish
Backs away to the full ball and drives it to long-off
Yorker on leg, flicked through midwicket
Wide and full outside off, easy leave, easy call for the ump as well
On a length on off, clipped through forward square leg
Spears it in on a length on off, clipped through midwicket. Sprints back to take two

Oh my word! Suryakumar is maps personified! He hangs back to the length ball that comes in just a touch, and delays his shot to steer it past short third. Brings up a 31-ball fifty in some style, raises his bat with some swag
Fuller on off, chipped towards cover
Throws it wide outside off, he hangs back and cuts it to deep point
Shortish and angling away, he goes back and across and mistimes the slap to cover
Now Pooran's athletic effort saves a boundary for LSG. Full and straight on middle, 139.5kph, SKY drills it straight back. Long-on runs to his left, dives full-stretch and keeps it in play

Slower length ball outside off, Suryakumar's supple wrists come into play to spoil Thakur's over. A four for MI after 13 balls. He stays put, waits an extra second before rolling his wrists to hit it wide of deep cover
Well done, Akash Deep! Dives to his right at short fine leg to save a certain four. Length ball on leg, Tilak clips it away and would have got more than just the single
Back of a length around leg, angling away, 115.3kph, Tilak hops to ramp but then leaves it. It goes over his head and wide called
Outside off on a length, 114.4kph, pushed towards cover
Slower one, slips from his hands and lands well wide of the tramline. Okay, speedgun says 135kph
Length ball on leg, punched down to long-on
Slower one, full outside off, slapped to deep cover, 111.1kph
Slows it down, full on off and middle, worked away towards mid-on with soft hands for a quick one
Spins away from a length, he taps it towards cover for a quick run but is sent back
Pitches well outside leg on a length, he clips it through forward square leg
Goes again with the wrong'un, reversed to backward point. Tilak is itching to put him away
Hangs back to the wrong'un again, punched back to the right of the non-striker
Goes back and mistimes his punch back to the bowler
Goes wide of the crease and spears it full outside off, he hangs back to slash but misses on the under-edge
Around the wicket, digs it in, off pace, Tilak pulls it through midwicket
Legcutter wide outside off, slapped to deep cover
SKY's speeding up! Another hit-me ball, he needs no second invitation. Full and outside off, Suryakumar leans into it and drills it through cover. Leans into it and holds his pose!
Creamed away in style. Effortless. Full length ball outside off, Suryakumar leans into it, delays the drive to play it square through the off side
Very full on middle, from wide of the crease, flicked to short midwicket
Goes straight, goes four and MI's 100 is up. Slows this up outside off, he picks his area and sends this over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
Length ball outside off, he cuts this Avesh's right at short third. They take a quick run
Fired in on a length on leg stump, he works this to deep midwicket
Flatter legbbreak on middle stump is whisked away by Surya to deep midwicket
Here comes Surya's signature shot. Googly on off stump, he steps right across and scoops him over short fine leg for a four
Flatter legbreak on middle and leg at 104.3kph. Tilak works this with soft hands to deep square leg and looks for two, but the fielder is quick on the ball
Legbreak darted in outside off as Tilak pushes to long-off for a run
Darted in on a length at 97.9kph on off, he works this to deep midwicket for a run
Carrom ball at 95.9kph on off, Surya pushes this back towards the bowler a little meekly
Flatter on middle stump, he brings out the sweep early and nails it to deep midwicket on the bounce
Googly first up that almost squares up Tilak. Was on middle turning away as Tilak defends

Cleans up Dhir right after the break and Rathi is pumped up. Legbreak at 96.3kph that just skids on after pitching. Dhir plays all around it and sees his off pole pushed back.  A bit of a send off as well from Rathi
Fired in on off and middle as Dhir works this to deep square leg

Darted on the shorter side on off, Dhir pulls and bisects the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket with precision. There is a case of yours and yours and ultimately, neither Pooran nor Akash Deep go for it
Flatter on off, he chips this to long-on on the bounce

Flatter outside off, he looks for a sweep, gets hit on the elbow and the ball speeds away across the turf with nothing short third can do. Oh, hang on, the umpire has given these runs. Surely, that was nowhere near the glove
Dragged down as Dhir goes back and pulls but does not get a clean connection. The ball falls just short of deep midwicket

Googly on off stump, he jumps down the track and gets a thick inside edge on to pad with the ball lobbing to the on-side. Bishnoi hares across and fires a throw at the stumps and ends up whacking his captain on the leg.
Back of a length ball outside off, he guides this deftly to the left of deep point where Miller dives and saves two runs
GORGEOUS! Right in Surya's slot outside off, was a slower delivery and the batters thumps the drive past mid-off. The 50-stand is up off 26 balls
Slower back of a length ball outside off, Dhir pulls to the right of deep midwicket where Samad gets around quickly
Oh, shot! Slower bouncer on off, he nails the pull and there is nothing deep midwicket can do there
Yorker on middle and leg, Dhir digs this back to the bowler

Oh, miscommunication and Dhir would have been out with a direct hit. Slower back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes to the right of extra cover and sets off. Markram moves around quickly and attempts a direct throw off balance. Dhir was a goner had he hit despite the dive. Markram was way off
Fired in on leg stump at pace, Dhir pushes to long-on
Gets this quicker and on a length at 98kph on off which he ticks towards midwicket for a quick run
Darted in on a length at 96.3kph on middle. He pushes to long-on for a run
Flatter length ball at 91.9kph on off as Surya eases to long-on
Short in length on off and middle, he takes a couple of steps down the track and pushes to long-on
Flatter but down leg, clips Dhir's pads and speeds away past short fine leg for a four

Surya into the act now. Back of a length ball outside off, he gets across and swats it away to the deep square leg fence for a 70m six. Didn't get it off the middle of the bat, the bat turned in his hand as well, but got enough power behind it
Goes fuller and on off stump as Dhir drives to the left of mid-off
Angles the length ball from wide of the crease as Surya pushes towards point for a run
On the half volley to the cover fielder. Good length ball outside off, he gets it off the cue end of the bat perilously close to the fielder
On a length outside off, he punches this on the up to extra cover
Starts with a length ball on off which he pushes towards mid-on for a quick run
Good length ball well outside off, he looks to force this through the offside, gets a bottom edge to the keeper on the bounce. 21 off the over and MI are away
Slower bouncer now outside off at 127.7kph. He gets in position early again and pulls to the left of deep square leg for a run
Fourth boundary in four balls and Dhir is all over Deep. Full and down leg, all Dhir has to do is get some bat on that. He does it with ease.
BANG! Dropped short on off and middle, he gets into position nice and early, rolls his wrists on top of the ball and pulls through square leg
TWO IN TWO! Oh, no stopping that. It's going only one direction. Short of good length on his pads and he just helps this over short fine leg and sends it sailing into the crowd

Going, going... and just enough to clear Bishnoi. Oh, he leapt but could not keep the ball inside the field of play. Back of a length ball on the stumps. He pulls, gets a good connection, and enough power to clear deep backward backward square lef
Length ball shaping away from Surya well outside off. He shoulders arms with the ball verrrry close to the tramline. The umpire rules in favour of the bowler
On a length just outside off, he pushes towards point and takes a run
STAND AND DELIVER! Oh, the audacity! Length ball outside off stump, Dhir stays firm and thumps this straight over the bowler's head for an 87m six.
Fullish in length on leg stump, he pushes this to mid-on and calls his partner through for a run

Big side of the boundary again and Bishnoi has taken another lovely catch. Back of a length ball on leg stump, Rickelton swats it away. He also gets a decent chunk on it but does not have enough power to clear Bishnoi who is stationed perfectly at deep backward square leg. MI in early trouble
In the air, in the gap and Rickelton gets four more. Length ball on his pads, all timing on the whip and he gets it in the gap between mid-on and midwicket
On a length on off, he steps across and whips this with power but Avesh does well at short midwicket
He is away with a couple of runs. Good length ball outside off, he punches this neatly to the right of deep for two

Deep strikes four balls into his first spell in three months and Jacks is out of here. Short of a good length hip high on leg stump. Jacks helps it away and gets a decent chunk on it but that is the bigger side of the ground and Bishnoi steadies himself to take a good catch right at the edge of the boundary circle at deep backward square leg
Short of a good length angling across Rickelton who punches to deep point
Sharp  back of a length ball at his midriff as he helps this to deep backward square leg for a run.
On a length to start off at 140.4kph just on off. He punches to cover point who misfields but there is a fielder to back him up
Sumptuous!  Half-volley outside off stump and Rickelton cashes in. Leans into the drive and crashes this through covers to get his boundary counter running
Fuller outside off stump, he opens the face of the blade and guides to deep point
A waft and a miss. A length ball with a hint of nibble into Jacks who gets across and looks to work it. Connects at thin air
Sharp inswinger on the fuller side on middle stump. Rickelton presents the full face of the bat and pushes past the bowler for a run
On a length with a hint of shape away from Jacks well outside off. He reaches for it eyeing a drive, skews it off the inside half of the bat to mid-on

An inside-edge first up and a misfield as well. Jacks on the board with a couple of runs. On a length with a hint of shape outside off. He pushes hard at it, gets a thick inside edge that goes perilously close to leg stump. Short fine leg lets through an extra run
